records.name: Joint Japan/World Bank Graduate Scholarship Program (JJ/WBGSP)
records.summary: The JJ/WBGSP is open to citizens of certain developing countries with relevant professional experience and a record of supporting their countries' development efforts who apply to a master's degree in a development-related topic. The scholarship covers tuition, a monthly living stipend, round-trip airfare, health insurance and a travel allowance.
records.sourceTitle: World Bank Scholarships Program - JJ/WBGSP
records.sourceNotes: The page says the program is open to citizens of certain developing countries and links to separate eligible-country windows; no country list was inferred for this record.
records.evidence: The JJ/WBGSP is open to citizens of certain developing countries with relevant professional experience and a history of supporting their countries' development efforts who are applying to a master's degree program in a development-related topic. A JJ/WBGSP scholarship provides tuition, a monthly living stipend, round-trip airfare, health insurance, and travel allowance.

records.name: Robert S. McNamara Fellowships Program
records.summary: The Robert S. McNamara Fellowships Program matched aspiring development economics researchers from developing countries with World Bank research economists for policy-relevant research at the World Bank. The official page states that the program is no longer receiving applications.
records.sourceTitle: Robert S. McNamara Fellowships Program
records.sourceNotes: Included as an official but inactive program; the source explicitly says it is no longer receiving applications.
records.evidence: The RSMFP program is no longer receiving applications. The World Bank's Robert S. McNamara Fellowships Program (RSMFP) matches aspiring development economics researchers from developing countries with World Bank research economists.

records.name: Chevening ASEAN Scholarship
records.providerName: Chevening (UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office)
records.summary: The Chevening ASEAN Scholarship is an opportunity for outstanding individuals from ASEAN member states or Timor-Leste to pursue a one-year master's degree in the UK with standard Chevening benefits and an enhanced regional programme. The official page says the scholarship is open to all fields of study.
records.sourceTitle: Chevening ASEAN Scholarship
records.sourceNotes: The page names ASEAN member states and Timor-Leste as the source of applicants but does not enumerate the member states; no country list was inferred.
records.evidence: The Chevening ASEAN Scholarship is an opportunity for outstanding individuals from ASEAN member states or Timor-Leste to pursue a one-year master's degree in the UK. The Chevening ASEAN Scholarship is open to all fields of study. There are no specific subject areas prioritised for this scholarship.

records.name: Chevening Oxford Centre for Islamic Studies (OCIS) Fellowship
records.providerName: Chevening (UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office)
fields: Science and technology in the Muslim world
The study of Muslims in the West
records.summary: The Chevening OCIS Fellowship supports mid-career professionals and academics from the listed countries undertaking five months of self-directed research at the Oxford Centre for Islamic Studies. The official page says applications are closed; the award covered living expenses, return economy airfare and an allowance package for research-related activities.
records.sourceTitle: Chevening Oxford Centre for Islamic Studies (OCIS) Fellowship
records.sourceNotes: The official page says applications are closed and notes that Afghanistan and Sudan citizens remain eligible for the fellowship route.
records.evidence: It is open to applications from mid-career professionals and academics who are dedicated to promoting academic activities that encourage a more informed understanding of the culture and civilisation of Islam and contemporary Muslim societies. Each fellowship includes living expenses for the duration of the fellowship, return economy airfare, and an allowance package for research-related activities.

records.name: Chevening LSE Global Impact Fellowship
records.providerName: Chevening (UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office)
records.summary: The Chevening LSE Global Impact Fellowship is for mid-career professionals from China carrying out a three- or six-month research project at the London School of Economics and Political Science. The official page says applications are closed; the award covered programme fees, living expenses, return airfare and a research allowance.
records.sourceTitle: Chevening LSE Global Impact Fellowship
records.sourceNotes: The official page says applications are closed.
records.evidence: It's for mid-career professionals from China who are interested in carrying out research in key thematic areas. Each fellowship includes full programme fees, living expenses for the duration of the fellowship, return economy airfare, and an allowance package for research-related activities.

records.name: Chevening Europe Defence and Security Fellowship
records.providerName: Chevening (UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office)
records.summary: The Chevening Europe Defence and Security Fellowship is a six-week programme delivered by Cranfield University at the Defence Academy of the United Kingdom for mid-career European professionals in security and defence. The official page says applications are closed; the award covered programme fees, living expenses including pre-arranged accommodation, and return economy airfare.
records.sourceTitle: Chevening Europe Defence and Security Fellowship
records.sourceNotes: The page enumerates eligible European countries and Gibraltar but was recorded as UNKNOWN because Gibraltar is not available in this catalog's country vocabulary; the official page also says applications are closed.
records.evidence: This Fellowship is open to all non-ODA eligible European countries. Each fellowship includes full programme fees, living expenses for the duration of the fellowship, including pre-arranged accommodation close to Oxford, and return economy airfare.

records.name: Chevening British Library Southeast Asian Fellowship
records.providerName: Chevening (UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office)
records.summary: The Chevening British Library Southeast Asian Fellowship funded a 12-month project researching early printed works in Cambodian, Lao and Thai languages at the British Library. The official page says applications are closed; the award included living expenses, return economy airfare, an activity allowance and up to £1,000 for approved project-related expenses.
records.sourceTitle: Chevening British Library Southeast Asian Fellowship
records.sourceNotes: The official page says applications are closed.
records.evidence: It is open to applications from mid-career professionals from Cambodia, Laos, and Thailand, who have a strong interest in surveying, assessing, and researching rare, printed works. Each fellowship includes up to £1,000 for approved project-related expenses.

records.evidence: It is open to applications from mid-career professionals from Egypt, Palestine, and Sudan, who have a strong interest in Coptic manuscript heritage and cultural collections. Each fellowship includes up to £1,000 for approved project-related expenses.

records.name: Chevening Gurukul Fellowship
records.providerName: Chevening (UK Foreign, Commonwealth and Development Office)
records.summary: The Chevening Gurukul Fellowship is a leadership programme for young and mid-career leaders from India and other backgrounds. The official source is an archived page for the 2024–2025 cohort and gives no current application status or funding details.
records.sourceTitle: Chevening Gurukul Fellows
records.sourceNotes: This is an archived cohort page describing 2024–2025 fellows; no current application status or funding details were stated.
records.evidence: This flagship fellowship addresses issues faced by leaders in all fields and explores changing ideas and practices of leadership, looking at the implications of globalisation for Indian leaders. It attracts young high-flyers and mid-career professional leaders from diverse backgrounds.

records.name: Fulbright U.S. Student Program
records.summary: The Fulbright U.S. Student Program sends U.S. citizens abroad for six months to one year to study, conduct research or teach English. The official program page does not state a single field scope or award amount.
records.sourceTitle: Fulbright U.S. Student Program | Exchange Programs
records.sourceNotes: This record is distinct from the Fulbright Foreign Student Program and Fulbright-Hays program already cataloged; the source page does not enumerate host countries or benefits.
records.evidence: The Fulbright U.S. Student Program offers opportunities for U.S. citizens to study, research, or teach English abroad. Awards are typically for six months to one year.

records.name: OPEC Fund Scholarship Award
records.summary: The OPEC Fund Scholarship Award supports outstanding young people from developing countries pursuing graduate studies in a development-related field. The official page states that the scholarship program is being restructured and is not accepting applications at this time.
records.sourceTitle: Scholarship - OPEC Fund for International Development
records.sourceNotes: Included as an official but currently closed program; no award amount or country list was stated.
records.evidence: The OPEC Fund Scholarship Award supports outstanding young individuals from developing countries so that they are able to pursue graduate studies in a development-related field. Kindly note that the OPEC Fund is currently restructuring its scholarship program and is not accepting applications at this time.

records.name: OFID/ICTP Postgraduate Fellowship Program
records.summary: The OFID/ICTP Postgraduate Fellowship Program supported PhD students from developing countries in physics, mathematics, earth sciences, ICT, renewable energy and related areas. The official page describes a past programme cycle with up to 15 students spending up to six months per year at ICTP or collaborating institutions, and gives no current application window or award amount.
records.sourceTitle: OFID/ICTP Postgraduate Fellowship Program - OPEC Fund for International Development
records.sourceNotes: The page describes a past program cycle and does not state a current application window or award amount.
records.evidence: This three-year program aims at strengthening the scientific capability of young postgraduate students from developing countries. Priority will be given to candidates from least-developed countries studying the fields of physics, mathematics, earth sciences, ICT, renewable energy and related areas.

records.name: South-South Fellowships & Human Resources Mobility Programs
records.summary: An OPEC Fund grant supported TWAS South-South Fellowships and human resources mobility programs for scientists from developing countries, mainly early-career researchers including PhD students, postdoctoral researchers and mobility awardees. The official page reports completed grant results rather than an open application cycle.
records.sourceTitle: South-South Fellowships & Human Resources Mobility Programs - OPEC Fund for International Development
records.sourceNotes: This is a grant/project page describing results, not a live application page; no fields of study or current funding amounts were stated.
records.evidence: The Grant supported a total number of 145 scientists from developing countries, most of which are early-career researchers including: 121 PhD students, 4 Post-doctoral researchers, and 20 awardees for mobility programmes.

records.name: IsDB Scholarship Program for Muslim Communities in Non-Member Countries (SPMC)
records.summary: The SPMC is one of the IsDB Scholarship Programs listed for 2027–2028. IsDB describes its scholarship programs as supporting academically qualified and financially needy students and scholars from Muslim communities in non-member countries.
records.sourceTitle: Scholarship Program for Muslim Communities in Non-Member Countries (SPMC)
records.sourceNotes: The publication page provides the program title, year and format; program level was taken from the official IsDB scholarship overview page, which describes SPMC as an undergraduate scholarship program. No country list, field list or award amount was stated on the page.
records.evidence: In response to the need to strengthen the human resources of Muslim communities in non-Member Countries (non-MCs), IsDB launched its Undergraduate Scholarship Program in 1983 under the title Scholarship Program for Muslim Communities (SPMC).

records.name: IsDB Master of Science Scholarship Program (M.Sc.) for Least Developed Member Countries
records.summary: The Master of Science Scholarship Program is one of the IsDB Scholarship Programs listed for 2027–2028 for IsDB least developed member countries. IsDB says its scholarship programs support academically qualified and financially needy students and scholars in priority fields.
records.sourceTitle: Master of Science Scholarship Program (M.Sc.) for IsDB Least Developed Member Countries
records.sourceNotes: The publication page provides the program title, year and format; the target group and level were taken from the official IsDB scholarship overview page. No specific countries, fields or award amount were inferred.
records.evidence: Subsequently, in 1998, IsDB launched the Master of Science Scholarship Program (M.Sc.) as a feeder program for the MSP, recognizing that 20 of the Least Developed Member Countries (LDMCs) had been unable to benefit from the latter.

records.name: IsDB Merit Scholarship Program for High Technology (MSP) for Member Countries
records.summary: The Merit Scholarship Program for High Technology is one of the IsDB Scholarship Programs listed for 2027–2028. IsDB established it to support PhD studies and post-doctoral research in applied sciences and high technology for institutions in member countries.
records.sourceTitle: Merit Scholarship Program for High Technology (MSP) for IsDB Member Countries
records.sourceNotes: The publication page provides the program title, year and format; level and fields were taken from the official IsDB scholarship overview page. No country list or award amount was inferred.
records.evidence: Building on a decade of experience with the SPMC, IsDB established the Merit Scholarship Program (MSP) in 1992 to support Ph.D. studies and post-doctoral research in applied sciences and high technology, with the aim of strengthening the scientific, technological, and research capacities of institutions in Member Countries (MCs).

records.name: IsDB ICF Undergraduate Scholarship Program for Least Developed Member Countries
records.summary: The ICF Undergraduate Scholarship Program is one of the IsDB Scholarship Programs listed for 2027–2028 for least developed member countries. IsDB launched the program in 2019 as part of its scholarship portfolio supporting financially needy students.
records.sourceTitle: ICF Undergraduate Program for Least Developed Members Countries
records.sourceNotes: The publication page provides the program title, year and format; level and target group were taken from the official IsDB scholarship overview page. No country list, field list or award amount was inferred.
records.evidence: In 2019, IsDB launched the ICF Undergraduate Scholarship Program for LDMCs. The Islamic Development Bank (IsDB) Scholarship Programs support academically qualified and financially needy students and scholars from IsDB Member Countries and Muslim communities in Non-Member Countries.
